pairs.why: A has a dark navy sky over a mid-value ground, so the white dome is separated by value like the night motel card. B is a washed, light grey-lilac field where the white hero sits close to the ground value.
A is mid-key with darker rocks and a soft vignette, like the real coral. B is a hot, high-key neon lime with a bright halo and no dark corners.
A has a deeper saturated blue backdrop that contrasts with the red gloves, closer to the real dark-blue wall. B's backdrop is lighter and paler.
Both booths have similar key, similar floor and wall value split and no clear vignette, so value gives no reason to choose.
Both ropes are tan on a mid purple wave background with the same key and soft contrast, with no value difference that favours either.
B has a soft light glow behind the booth that lifts it off the green wall, as the real card does. A's wall is flat.
B's grass is slightly deeper and darker toward the edges, so its value structure sits a little closer to the real card's shaded meadow. A is a bit brighter and flatter.
Both use a pale high-key striped wall instead of the real darker wood. Both heroes are similarly bright with the same local contrast.
